import pandas as pd

def run(inputs: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
    inbound = inputs.get("inbound", pd.DataFrame(columns=["product_id", "batch_date", "qty", "unit_cost"]))
    target_snapshot = inputs.get(
        "target_snapshot",
        pd.DataFrame(columns=["product_id", "batch_date", "total_qty", "max_unit_cost"]),
    )

    # Step 1: STG_NEW = SELECT product_id, batch_date, SUM(qty) AS total_qty,
    #                          MAX(unit_cost) AS max_unit_cost
    #          FROM inbound WHERE qty > 0 GROUP BY product_id, batch_date
    filtered = inbound[inbound["qty"] > 0]

    if filtered.empty:
        stg_new = pd.DataFrame(columns=["product_id", "batch_date", "total_qty", "max_unit_cost"])
    else:
        stg_new = (
            filtered.groupby(["product_id", "batch_date"], as_index=False, dropna=False)
            .agg(total_qty=("qty", "sum"), max_unit_cost=("unit_cost", "max"))
        )

    # Step 2: DELETE FROM TARGET_SNAPSHOT WHERE batch_date IN (SELECT DISTINCT batch_date FROM STG_NEW)
    arriving_dates = set(stg_new["batch_date"].unique())

    if arriving_dates:
        remaining = target_snapshot[~target_snapshot["batch_date"].isin(arriving_dates)]
    else:
        remaining = target_snapshot.copy()

    # Step 3: INSERT INTO TARGET_SNAPSHOT SELECT * FROM STG_NEW
    result = pd.concat([remaining, stg_new], ignore_index=True)

    result = result[["product_id", "batch_date", "total_qty", "max_unit_cost"]]

    return {"target_snapshot": result}
